entries.title: Scientists achieve record-breaking low temperature on China's space station, paving the way for new physics experiments
entries.summary: Matter starts to behave differently at extremely low temperatures, creating conditions ideal for studying quantum physics and new states of matter. Now, researchers from China have achieved a new low-temperature record aboard their Tiangong space station. Their research,…

entries.title: From chaos to 'intelligent' soft matter—how tiny chemical differences guide droplets into ordered structures
entries.summary: Disorder can make sense, and understanding its logic can be genuinely useful. A study by a research group at the University of Trento shows how a minimal chemical difference can turn chaotic, disordered motion into a highly coordinated and reproducible structure.
